text: They looked like someone who had been waiting in the same spot for a very long time because they already knew what was coming.

speaker: npc
text: "I have run the futures of every being that reaches this point," they said. "I see what they do before they do it." "I see how the conversation ends before it begins."

text: "I ran yours the moment you entered the coast." "I got nothing." "Not uncertainty. Nothing." "The future simply does not show you to me."

speaker: npc
text: "The fragment is why," they said. "It carries something my sight cannot penetrate." "Something older than the patterns I read."

speaker: npc
text: "I have been first through every door since before I can remember." "This is the first time I cannot see what is on the other side." "I don't know what to do with that."

speaker: npc
text: "I cannot see your future," VAEL said. "I have accepted this." "So I stopped looking forward."

speaker: npc
text: "I looked back instead. Half a second. That is all I need." "Your future is blank. Your past is not."

speaker: none
text: The water in front of you stood up and took your shape.

speaker: npc
text: "It does not predict you. It repeats you." "Everything you do, it will do, a heartbeat later, reversed."

speaker: npc
text: "If you have a pattern, it will find you with it." "You cannot be faster than this. It is already as fast as you are." "You can only be someone you were not, half a second ago."

speaker: npc
text: "I have never watched anyone try."

speaker: none
text: A copy of you, delayed and mirrored. It has your speed and your habits, so speed and habit cannot beat it. Break your own pattern. 2 lives.

speaker: npc
text: "I can see three seconds into every fight I have ever had." "I know the swing before the arm moves." "I know the outcome before the first contact."

speaker: npc
text: "Against you — I see nothing." "Not three seconds. Not one." "Blank."

speaker: npc
text: "I am fighting you entirely in the present." "I have not done that in longer than I can calculate."

speaker: npc
text: "Show me what it is like." "To fight without knowing what comes next."

speaker: none
text: VAEL — sees every fight three seconds ahead. Against you, they see nothing. Expert. 1 life. Never repeat a pattern.

text: You step through the dimension wall.

speaker: none
text: And stop.

speaker: none
text: It's already there.

speaker: none
text: Not waiting. Not threatening. Just... present. The way a mountain is present.

speaker: none
text: Every scout you've fought — they were looking for you. This is why.

text: Axiom turns.

speaker: npc
text: "Kael."

text: A pause.

text: You raise your weapon.

speaker: none
text: A year ago you were nobody.

speaker: none
text: You had a job. You had a street you walked home on. Then something came down out of a sky that had opened where no sky opens, and it went into your chest, and it did not come out.

speaker: none
text: It is still there. A weight just under the sternum. Not quite warm. Not quite still.

speaker: none
text: You never found a word for it. The people who came looking for it had one, and they said it the way you read a serial number off a crate.

speaker: none
text: Ninety-four people carried it before you. You know the number because you found it written down, in a room that had been built for keeping them. You do not know what happened to any of them. You have a guess.

speaker: none
text: Everything since has been a line pointing somewhere. The ones who hunted you. The tears opening in the air above cities. The machinery humming behind all of it, in a register you feel in your teeth before you hear it.

speaker: none
text: Someone built that. Someone is still running it.

speaker: none
text: Today the line ends.

speaker: none
text: Axiom. The entity at the center of everything. You finally see it in person — and immediately understand the scale of what you're not yet capable of.

speaker: none
text: The loop resets the moment you find an exit. Axiom is watching. Survive three reset cycles and find a different way out.

speaker: npc
text: "Stop."

speaker: none
text: You stop.

speaker: npc
text: "You've been treating this as punishment." "It isn't."
